title: An Email from Anna
text:
Hi Tom! How are you? I am in London now. I am staying with my friend Lucy. The weather is cold, but the city is very nice.

Yesterday we visited a big museum. It was free and very interesting. Tonight we are going to a small Italian restaurant. Please write back soon!

questions.text: What did the writer and Lucy do yesterday?
How does the writer feel about the city?
Why does the writer say 'Please write back soon!'?
options: They want an answer from Tom

vocabulary.definition: the conditions outside, such as sun, rain or cold
a building where people can see old or special objects
making you want to learn more or pay attention
living somewhere for a short time

paragraph_translations: Привіт, Томе! Як справи? Я зараз у Лондоні. Я зупинилася у своєї подруги Люсі. Погода холодна, але місто дуже гарне.
Вчора ми відвідали великий музей. Він був безкоштовний і дуже цікавий. Сьогодні ввечері ми йдемо в маленький італійський ресторан. Будь ласка, напиши мені незабаром!
